grammar.label: it + adjective + to-infinitive / that-clause
grammar.form: It is important to…; It is clear that…
grammar.meaning: putting the comment before the fact

explanation.en: English avoids a heavy subject at the front. 'It is difficult to explain' is natural; 'To explain is difficult' is not.
explanation.uz: Ingliz tili og'ir egani gap boshida qoldirmaydi. 'It is difficult to explain' tabiiy; 'To explain is difficult' esa emas.

grammar.positive_example: It is clear that the plan needs changing.
grammar.negative_example: Is clear that the plan needs changing.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada 'kerak', 'muhim' egasiz kelaveradi; ingliz tilida 'it' tushib qolmaydi.

grammar.label: three-part phrasal verbs
grammar.form: put up with; look forward to; get on with
grammar.meaning: verb plus two particles acting as one unit

explanation.en: These never separate, and the object always follows both particles: 'I look forward to it', never 'I look it forward to'. After 'to' in 'look forward to' comes an -ing form.
explanation.uz: Bular hech qachon ajralmaydi va to'ldiruvchi ikkala bo'lakdan keyin keladi: 'I look forward to it'. 'look forward to' dagi 'to' dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

grammar.positive_example: I am looking forward to hearing from you.
grammar.negative_example: I am looking forward to hear from you.

l1_notes.uz: 'to' bu yerda predlog, infinitiv belgisi emas — shuning uchun -ing keladi.
